Extremely Overpriced for What You Get and Dubious Claims. I am very skeptical regarding the claims made on the box. On the front of the box they claim the cloths are "designed to reduce fine lines & wrinkles." This claim is absolute nonsense. The box also states that the face towel is "A 100% handmade silk face towel.". This is false. The underside of the cloth is 50% cotton. They should put this info on the box itself, but they don't. It's misleading and diminishes their credibility.

The box claims that this cloth can brighten dull & uneven skin. I am skeptical this cloth has special powers that can do this on its own.

Save your money and do not spend so much for just 2 cloths that are not even 100% silk. These cloths do not offer the equivalent value for what is being charged
